summary: Van Oord is dutch dredging company, founded in 1868. Type: private company. About 5,000 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 87% of its 15 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 4 about growth or hiring.

culture.text: A Dutch family-owned company that values visible leadership and a long-term view.
Staff often studied at TU Delft, Rotterdam UAS, Erasmus, The Hague UAS or Avans, mostly civil or mechanical engineering.

open.text: Van Oord Personeels B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Profit more than doubled in a strong operational year.
Won, with Boskalis, a US$580 million dredging contract to expand Sweden's Port of Luleå.
Was selected as preferred contractor for Roberts Bank Terminal 2 in Canada.
Is building two new fallpipe vessels, Vindnes and Vestnes, for subsea rock installation.

worth_knowing.text: Worked on the renewed Afsluitdijk, which has now opened.
